title: Exit 8
review: The framing story isn't that good, but one thing that I have to commend this film for, is how similar it looks and feels to the video game it's adapting. This is extremely faithful to the layout and aesthetic of the game, and because the gameplay involves spotting visual clues, you can play along as you watch. No video game adaptation has ever felt closer to the source material. Obviously it's a similar project to {Backrooms}; another adaptation dealing with liminal spaces, where mundane hallways are iterated upon endlessly. Backrooms is the better film, but this is more playful.
